_comment: Data-driven error signatures. To teach the skill a new error: add an entry here AND a real sample in tests/fixtures/samples.json (test_every_signature_has_a_matching_sample_fixture enforces it). Order matters: first match wins. kind: quota = harness exhausted (switch away), transient = short rate limit (ignore), auth = needs human login. reset: how to read the recovery time out of the message.

signatures.pattern: hit your usage limit|usage limit reached|insufficient_quota
